comment: She is a great prof and is super knowledgeable. Class was very interesting but there was a large workload and a lot of readings. There was a large paper at the end of the class which was difficult but overall the class was very intriguing and discussions were good.

Amazing professor! She is understanding and caring and gives comprehensive study guides before each exam so you know exactly what is on the test. She does assign homework for almost every class but you go over it during class before turning it in anyway. Her classes are always fun and engaging. If you have the chance to take her class, take it.

She was probably one of my funnest teachers.  Very relaxed in class, very easy to joke around with. She seems to feel exhausted after speaking English for a long time, but other than that, Russian Cinema was my favorite class.
